latest.title: Spectator Overview Objective Reveal Fix
latest.summary: Full-map spectator overview now shows rifts and exits correctly
latest.description: Fixed spectator Overview mode so rift/generator visuals force full visibility, completed rifts are still sent to overview snapshots, and sealed or open exit portals render in the full-map director view. Switching into or out of Overview now forces dynamic and rift layers to redraw so objects do not remain hidden from the previous POV.

history.title: Spectator Overview Objective Reveal Fix
history.summary: Full-map spectator overview now shows rifts and exits correctly
history.description: Fixed spectator Overview mode so rift/generator visuals force full visibility, completed rifts are still sent to overview snapshots, and sealed or open exit portals render in the full-map director view. Switching into or out of Overview now forces dynamic and rift layers to redraw so objects do not remain hidden from the previous POV.

history.title: Spectator Overview Camera
history.summary: Spectators can Tab into a full-map overview with everything revealed
history.description: Added a dedicated spectator Overview target after cycling through all live players with Tab. Overview mode centers the camera on the full map, computes a fit-to-screen zoom with configurable padding, reveals all actors, walls, hooks, rifts, dots, and scratch marks, and keeps normal player-target spectating unchanged for Runners and The Void.

history.title: Spectator Camera Follow Fix
history.summary: Dedicated spectators now load into the map and follow selected targets correctly
history.description: Fixed the in-game spectator camera so dedicated spectators use the same spectating path as dead Runners: the map renders normally, the camera follows the currently watched actor, Tab and Shift+Tab cycle through living Runners and The Void, and spectator input stays fully blocked from movement, attack, chat, and ability controls.

history.title: Pre-Match Spectator Slot
history.summary: Lobby setup now has a real Join as Spectator role button
history.description: Added Join as Spectator directly beneath Play as The Void and Play as a Runner inside the run lobby setup screen. Players can switch into an auto-ready spectator role before the match begins, remain unable to ready or switch back into a playable role from that lobby, still manage bots and start valid bot/friend lobbies, and load into the run watching instead of controlling a character.

history.title: Open Lobby Spectator Button Verification
history.summary: Open lobby rows explicitly show Join as Spectator
history.description: Double-checked the open lobby list renderer and reinforced the Join as Spectator action on every lobby row with a dedicated action marker, clearer Play screen copy, and visible Open Lobbies helper text so players can join waiting or active lobbies as auto-ready spectators without taking a playable slot.

history.title: Spectator Lobby Ready Polish
history.summary: Open lobbies now clearly support joining as an auto-ready spectator
history.description: Renamed the open-lobby spectate action to Join as Spectator, clarified that spectators are auto-ready and optional for match start, forced spectator ready state in lobby broadcasts and start checks, and styled the disabled spectator-ready button so viewers cannot accidentally change readiness or block the run.

history.title: Lobby Spectator Mode
history.summary: Players can join lobbies as spectators and watch active runs
history.description: Added a Spectate button to open lobbies so players can enter a watch-only role, including runs already in progress. Spectators are listed separately in the lobby, cannot ready, change roles, start the run, move, chat, or use abilities, and can cycle camera targets with Tab/Shift+Tab including The Void. Server snapshots now include dedicated spectator viewer metadata and route visibility through the selected target's point of view.

history.title: Bot Personalities and Buff Alert Polish
history.summary: Runner bots now get match-start personalities and the Void buff alert is red
history.description: Added Runner bot personality assignments at match start with Scout, Medic, Banker, Looper, and Generalist behavior profiles. A lone living Runner bot now falls back to Generalist decision-making so one-bot teams still collect, rescue, heal, deposit, and escape instead of staying trapped in one specialty. Personality names are applied when the run starts, objective scoring now weights support, orbs, deposits, and looping by role, and The Void has been buffed notification now uses a red alert style.

history.title: Chase Audio and Speed Boost Polish
history.summary: Killer chase camera stays stable, chase music plays for The Void, and boosts get trails/audio
history.description: Kept The Void camera at its normal zoom during chase while still giving the killer layer_3 chase music, reset the endgame floor treatment when a match ends, added a survivor Speed Burst trail effect, and added a local-only speed_boost.mp3 cue for Runner Speed Burst and Void Null Rush activations.

history.title: Hourglass Trails and Endgame Buff
history.summary: Hourglass replaces Stealth Step, Speed Burst is added, and completed rifts empower The Void
history.description: Removed Stealth Step from the Runner wheel and folded its scratch-mark hiding into Hourglass, added the new Speed Burst Runner ability with a small 5-second speed boost, added an endgame floor treatment when all rifts are complete, and gave The Void a permanent smaller speed buff after rifts are finished. All-rifts-complete announcements now stack and follow with a delayed Void-buffed warning.

history.title: Performance Mode Threshold
history.summary: Low performance mode now only auto-enables below 55 FPS
history.description: Changed adaptive performance so hardware hints no longer force low mode at startup. The game now starts in normal mode and only enables low performance mode after measured FPS drops below the configurable lowFps threshold, now set to 55, while still staying stable once triggered to avoid mode-flapping during gameplay.

history.title: Non-Sprint Vision Cone
history.summary: Runner cone is bigger whenever sprint is not held
history.description: Changed Runner vision so the wider cone applies any time Shift/sprint is not being held, including standing still and normal walking. Holding sprint immediately returns the cone to its normal base size. The same non-sprinting cone multipliers are now read by both the client visuals and server visibility checks, with configurable values in gameplayConfig.

history.title: Ability Wheel and Camera Smoothing
history.summary: Hourglass moved left, Cancel moved bottom, and camera zoom blends slower
history.description: Reordered the Runner ability wheel so Hourglass sits on the left segment and Cancel sits on the bottom segment, then slowed the camera zoom interpolation and tightened the snap threshold so chase, sprint, action, hook, and ability zoom changes feel smoother instead of jarring.

history.title: Hook Camera and Walking Vision Tuning
history.summary: Hooked camera is closer and walking gives Runners a wider cone
history.description: Raised the hooked-unrescued camera zoom from the extreme 0.3 view to a slightly-above-default focused view, added configurable walking-only Runner vision cone multipliers, and mirrored the walking vision math on both client visuals and server visibility so sprinting keeps the base cone while walking grants more awareness.

history.title: Start Cue Layer 1 Blend
history.summary: layer_1 now fades in immediately while start.mp3 plays
history.description: Changed the match-start music blend so layer_1 begins fading in at the same time start.mp3 starts playing instead of waiting for the intro cue to reach its fade-out window. Lowered the start cue volume again through the audio config and fallback defaults.

history.title: Start Cue and Layer 2 Volume Tuning
history.summary: start.mp3 is easier to tune and warning music is toned down
history.description: Added an explicit start intro volume entry to the music layer volume config, lowered the match-start cue volume, reduced the layer_2 warning bed multiplier, and toned down the layer_2 gameplay target volumes while keeping its smooth fade behavior intact.

history.title: Hooked Camera Zoom Out
history.summary: Hooked Runners zoom out to 0.3 when no rescue is active
history.description: Added a dedicated hooked camera state. When the camera subject is a hooked Runner and unhook progress has not started, the camera uses the configured absolute hookedUnrescuedZoom value of 0.3. Once a rescue begins, normal additive camera rules resume so action and chase modifiers can behave predictably.

history.title: Sprint Only Camera Zoom
history.summary: Movement zoom now only applies while holding sprint
history.description: Corrected the additive camera rules so walking stays at the neutral base zoom and the movement zoom offset only applies while a Runner is actively holding Shift to sprint. Chase, action, and ability offsets still stack from the base zoom and clamp against the configured max in/out offsets.

history.title: Additive Camera Zoom System
history.summary: Camera zoom is now base plus clamped gameplay modifiers
history.description: Rebuilt the camera zoom system around a config-driven additive stack: base zoom plus chase, walking, sprinting, action, and ability modifiers. Zoom is smoothly blended, clamped to configurable max in/out offsets, Rift Lens can zoom out while chase still zooms in, and server snapshots now include movement/sprinting state so spectating and bot cameras use the same rules.

history.title: Start Music Fade Fix
history.summary: start.mp3 fade math now uses finite safe volume values
history.description: Fixed the match-start music crossfade so the start.mp3 volume setter never receives NaN or Infinity, corrected the smoothstep fade helper to support one-argument fade gates safely, and hardened fallback duration math so layer_1 can fade in cleanly even if the cue duration is not loaded yet.

history.title: Manual Camera Zoom Reset
history.summary: Camera zoom is now controlled by small dev buttons instead of gameplay effects
history.description: Removed the automatic gameplay camera zoom system and replaced it with a clean manual zoom test setup. Small top-center dev controls now set the camera to the default zoom, default plus 0.5x, or default minus 0.5x so the next camera pass can be tuned from a stable baseline.

history.title: Match Start Music Intro
history.summary: start.mp3 now plays at run start and crossfades into layer_1
history.description: Added a match-start music cue that plays public/sfx/start.mp3 when the run begins, holds layer_1 silent during the cue, fades start.mp3 out, and smoothly fades layer_1 in afterward. The cue gracefully falls back to normal layer_1 music if start.mp3 is missing or unavailable.

history.title: Hourglass Vision Polish
history.summary: Rift Lens reveal fix, farther camera, red pickup FX, and Hourglass Runner ability
history.description: Fixed Runner vision reveal math so Rift Lens reveals The Void and actors inside the widened cone, zoomed the default camera out more while keeping sprint zoom as a tradeoff, made red orb pickups burst red, and added the Hourglass Runner ability: 10 orbs, 5 second duration, 30 second cooldown, with a second rear vision cone.

history.title: Runner Deposit and Brave AI
history.summary: Runner bots deposit at 8 orbs and stop over-panicking at terror radius
history.description: Runner bots now cash out at the closest unfinished rift once they carry eight or more orbs, stop committing to dot collection while loaded, treat audible terror radius as caution instead of automatic flee, and use braver objective routing for safe-ish orbs, rifts, heals, and rescues unless The Void has line-of-sight or close chase pressure.

history.title: Layer 2 Music Presence
history.summary: Layer 2 warning music now plays farther out with smoother fades
history.description: Restored and strengthened the layer_2 warning music by giving it a wider server-side trigger radius, a smooth distance ramp, a faint chase bed under layer_3, stronger layer volume, and a slightly slower client fade so threat music breathes in and out cleanly instead of barely appearing.

history.title: Sprint Camera and Smarter Pallets
history.summary: Runner sprint zoom, faster orb flow, and stun-aware bot pallet drops
history.description: Added a small additive Runner sprint camera zoom so walking keeps the wider default view, increased orb spawn density and respawn cadence, and tightened Runner bot pallet use so bots treat pallets as stun/escape resources instead of randomly dropping them whenever The Void is merely nearby.

history.title: Void M1 Hitbox Polish
history.summary: M1 visuals now match server hit timing and Runner body overlap
history.description: Aligned The Void M1 attack visuals with server-authoritative active timing, aged swipe visuals by server time so delayed snapshots cannot show stale hit cones, updated charge previews to use the real quick/lunge ranges and arcs, and changed hit testing to use Runner body overlap instead of center-point-only checks so visible cone clips connect consistently.

history.title: Boosted Netcode Polish
history.summary: Smoother boosted-host networking and input cadence
history.description: Raised boosted snapshot cadence, switched the game socket path to WebSocket-only transport, added fixed-tick server catch-up for short event-loop hiccups, added steady rate-limited human input heartbeats, and added client-side snapshot jitter padding so movement stays smoother without piling up stale packets.

history.title: Mouse and Keyboard Gate
history.summary: Mobile devices now see a simple desktop-only message
history.description: Added a source-level mobile and tablet gate that prevents the game client from loading on touch/mobile devices and shows a simple RiftRunner page saying the game is just for mouse and keyboard.

history.title: Omniscient Runner Escape AI
history.summary: Runner bots always account for The Void and choose real escape routes
history.description: Updated Runner bot chase behavior so server-controlled bots always know The Void's position, abandon objectives under map-aware pressure, route toward windows and pallets, reject dead-end and corner escape tiles, score follow-up escape lanes after vaults, and keep moving along routes with safe exits instead of drifting into map edges.

history.title: Performance and AI Polish
history.summary: Adaptive polish for low-end PCs, high-end effects, and sturdier Runner bots
history.description: Added high-fidelity visual scaling for stronger machines, reduced low-power DOM and Graphics churn, throttled redundant actor restyling, lowered UI animation pressure in performance modes, and tightened Runner bot flee behavior so chase targets reject dead zones and recover out of corners toward usable loops or safer center routes.

history.title: Runner Looping AI
history.summary: Runner bots chain windows and pallets instead of corners
history.description: Updated Runner bot chase behavior to prefer Dead by Daylight-style loop resources, chain toward windows and pallets, heavily avoid map edge deadzones and corners, and redirect after one second without movement so stalled bots pick a new chase route instead of standing in place.

history.title: Low Power Movement Deep Fix
history.summary: Smoother low-performance play and Runner bot unstuck logic
history.description: Reduced low-power render pressure, removed camera smoothing from local controlled movement, throttled local collision overlap checks without giving up server authority, and added Runner bot direction-change recovery so bots abandon corners and stalled objective paths after one second.

history.title: Performance Mode Polish
history.summary: Smoother low-power movement and Void POV
history.description: Improved low-performance play by optimizing local movement prediction with nearby collision checks, smoothing The Void's local and remote position updates, reducing expensive lighting and visibility redraws on weaker clients, and keeping Runner-side low-power movement responsive while preserving server-authoritative positions.

history.title: Smarter Bot AI
history.summary: More tactical Runner and Void bots
history.description: Improved bot pathfinding with diagonal A* movement, path smoothing, stuck recovery, smarter objective scoring, stronger Void target selection, more human Runner rescue/heal/deposit priorities, tactical loop use, and server-side bot ability usage for Void and Runner abilities.

history.title: Point Feed and M1 Polish
history.summary: Compact point notifications and better quick M1 range
history.description: Added a React-driven top-left point feed for tracked stat gains, slimmed and widened the end results scoreboard with The Void always listed first, added Runner Void stun tracking, and made quick M1 taps use a more forgiving cone with better range and startup timing.

history.title: Pallet Impact Polish
history.summary: Broken pallet X and stun shake
history.description: Updated broken pallets to read as a glowing purple X in the middle and made pallet stuns trigger stronger camera shake feedback for The Void, the stunning Runner, and nearby players.

history.title: Compact End Results
history.summary: Slimmer end-game scoreboard
history.description: Restyled the run ended results screen into a compact, horizontal scoreboard with slimmer player rows and renamed The Void death stat to Runners consumed.

history.title: End Match Stats
history.summary: Post-run scorecards for Runners and The Void
history.description: Added server-tracked end-game stats for each Runner and The Void, including orbs collected/deposited, heals, unhooks, escape status, chase time, rift kicks, injures, hooks, deaths, and Void abilities used. The run ended screen now renders a scorecard for every player.

history.title: Void Sight and Downed Pings
history.summary: Reveal cooldowns and downed runner rings
history.description: Replaced Hollow Leech with Void Sight, which costs 15 Void Orbs, reveals all Runners for 5 seconds, and pulls The Void camera back while active. Void abilities now each use a 20 second cooldown, and downed Runners emit a pulsing red ring once per second so teammates can find crawling players more easily.

history.title: Void HUD Polish
history.summary: Void orb HUD, audio pitch, and role polish
history.description: Added the missing always-visible bottom-right Void orb counter update path, kept Runner orb pickup pitch ramping while returning Void orb pickup audio to random pitch variation, reduced Hollow Leech to 8 orbs, removed the old Null Rush tail effect while keeping quick white bubbles, improved bot button tinting, and made selected role buttons stay clearly highlighted.

history.title: Void Ability Polish
history.summary: Cancel wheel, stronger leech, and lobby polish
history.description: Removed Gravity Well from the Void wheel and replaced the bottom slot with Cancel. Hollow Leech now steals half of each Runner's carried orbs and forces stolen Runners to use orb-loss chatter. Added a bottom-right Void orb counter, polished lobby setup ordering and button colors, made Void role marks purple/black, and improved Null Rush with quick white bubble trails.

history.title: Void Abilities
history.summary: Void orb economy and ability wheel
history.description: Added The Void ability wheel on Q, Void orb currency gained from hits, Null Rush speed boost, Redshift Bloom corrupted orbs, Gravity Well slow pulse, Hollow Leech orb steal, a Void orb HUD, red orb visuals, and ability effects.

history.title: Shared Chat Polish
history.summary: Shared chat lines, full orb drops, and lobby polish
history.description: Added a shared chats.js file used by both the client and server so quick-chat wheel labels match the lines that actually appear in game. Runners now drop all carried orbs when hit, spectating can target hooked runners, the open lobby is vertically centered, lobby skins list top-to-bottom, Void player grouping uses purple styling, and bot button order was swapped.

history.title: Lobby and Spectate Polish
history.summary: Cleaner lobby, spectate hint, and smoother intro
history.description: Moved bot controls under the role selector, aligned the open lobby to the left, widened and stabilized the roster layout, changed bot removal copy to Kick, added a spectate control hint above the runner cards, tightened spectate eligibility, made downed runners use downed chatter reliably, darkened the Void lobby mark, lowered void stun audio, and removed intro zoom conflicts that caused first-camera hitching.

history.title: Runner Polish
history.summary: Runners renamed, wider lobby, smoother intro
history.description: Player-facing Rift role wording was renamed to Runners while objective Rifts remain unchanged. The open lobby panel now uses the full available width more reliably, Audio and How to Play copy was cleaned up, The Void instructions mention holding E for hooks and rift kicks, and the match intro now primes the camera and locks movement input until the startup zoom finishes.

history.title: Lobby Ready Polish
history.summary: Wider lobby, ready-gated starts, and cleaner labels
history.description: Open lobby roster width was expanded, Void players wording replaced candidate copy, the ready button moved directly under Start Run with clearer styling, humans must all ready up before the run can start while bots stay ready automatically, survivor status no longer shows Chased, and menu copy was tightened.

history.title: Run Polish
history.summary: Cleaner lobby, HUD, rescues, and audio
history.description: Unhook audio now plays only when the rescue finishes and only for involved players. The open lobby is wider, Settings and How to Play are cleaner, Bot wording is restored, the match HUD keeps only the role card and FPS, speech text is larger, and injured/healing/unhook volumes were reduced.

history.title: Release Polish
history.summary: riftrunner naming and release polish
history.description: Updated player-facing branding to riftrunner, changed the player team label to Rifts in the interface, cleaned lobby echo wording, removed placeholder menu links, and polished release-facing menu copy.

history.title: Lobby Roster Groups
history.summary: Void candidates grouped above survivors
history.description: Open lobby now places setup controls on the left and the player roster on the right. The roster is grouped with Void candidates on top and survivors below, and the list aligns from the top of its panel instead of sitting centered in the available space.

history.title: Lobby Flow Polish
history.summary: Wider lobby layout and fade transitions
history.description: Open lobby now uses a wider two-column layout with a taller player roster to reduce nested scrollbars. Game-to-end and end-to-spectate screen changes now fade through black for smoother death, escape, and spectate transitions.

history.title: Lobby Bot Control
history.summary: Kick lobby bots and queue multiple Voids
history.description: Lobby bots can now be removed before a match starts, including survivor bots and Void bots. Multiple players can select The Void in the lobby, but match start is still blocked unless exactly one Void and at least one Survivor are selected.

history.title: Healing Forgiveness
history.summary: Interrupted heals decay and rescues get audio
history.description: Healing progress now drains slowly after an interrupted heal instead of snapping to zero when movement breaks the assist, and unhooking now plays a private rescue loop for the rescuer and the hooked survivor only.

history.title: Pallet Drop Commitment
history.summary: Pallet drops now lock instant vaults
history.description: Dropping a pallet now applies the same short survivor pallet commitment lockout used by pallet vaults, preventing survivors from slamming a pallet and immediately jumping over it on the next Space press.

history.title: Hit Chatter
history.summary: Survivors react when hit or downed
history.description: Survivors now automatically say short reactive chat lines when they are hit or downed, including orb-loss jokes when they were carrying orbs.

history.title: Pallet Commitment
history.summary: Stronger orb pitch and pallet vault lockout
history.description: Orb pickup pitch now ramps more noticeably from 1.00 to 1.45 by the tenth carried orb. Dropped pallet vaulting now uses the same one-at-a-time lock and survivor cooldown style as windows, and the local hit-impact event handler no longer references the heavy impact flag outside its scope.

history.title: Orb Pickup Pitch
history.summary: Orb pickup sound climbs with carried orbs
history.description: Orb pickup audio now uses the player's carried orb count instead of random pitch variation. The pitch starts at 1.00 on the first carried orb and ramps up to 1.10 by the tenth orb.

history.title: Window Commitment
history.summary: One-at-a-time windows with survivor cooldown
history.description: Window vaulting is now server-locked so only one player can pass through a window at a time, including survivors and The Void. Survivors also get a short cooldown after window vaults so they cannot spam back-and-forth jumps.

history.title: Hit Impact
history.summary: Survivor hit shake and grayscale flash
history.description: Adds a stronger local impact effect when the survivor is hit or downed, including screen shake, a brief grayscale/desaturation flash, and a quick hit overlay pulse.

history.title: Healing Pulse
history.summary: Green healing rings and scaling healing audio
history.description: Adds a green pulsing circle around survivors while they are being healed and loops sfx/healing.mp3 with a slightly higher pitch when more nearby survivors are helping.

history.title: Pallet Control
history.summary: Cleaner pallet drops and hooked visibility
history.description: Fixed stale pallet action direction so standing still beside an upright pallet drops it instead of moving/vaulting across. Hooked survivors now remain visible to survivor teammates anywhere on the map, independent of cone and line of sight.

history.title: Auto Rescue
history.summary: Proximity healing and rescues
history.description: Survivors now heal and rescue hooked teammates by standing still very close to them instead of holding E. Nearby stationary allies can contribute at the same time, and moving cancels the assist progress.

history.title: Action Bars Restored
history.summary: Under-player action bars restored
history.description: Restored scene-level healing, rescue, hook, and execute progress bars underneath players so they stay fixed below actors instead of rotating or disappearing.

history.title: Version Tracking
history.summary: Main menu version log online
history.description: Added a version.json changelog and a bottom-right main menu badge that displays the latest version and short title.
